svg.title: The eight filters it taught itself
svg.desc: Eight 3 by 3 grids, one per learned filter, with each cell coloured green for a positive weight and red for a negative one and marked with a plus or minus sign. Filter 6 has its whole left column positive - 0.509, 0.382, 0.761 - and its whole right column negative - minus 0.149, minus 0.767, minus 0.550. Sliding a bright-left edge past it gives 0.529 plus 0.642 plus 1.659 equals 2.830, while a bright-top edge gives minus 1.219. Filter 4 is the same idea rotated and answers plus 3.760 to a bright-top edge.
svg.text: The eight filters it taught itself
green cell = a positive weight (+) · red cell = a negative weight (−)
left column all +, right column all −
slide a bright-left edge past it:

so filter 6 says: vertical edge here
Filter 4, badge 1, is the same idea on its side: bright top, dark bottom, +3.760.
